notes.title: Update v2.0 enhancements. (Please reset your graphic settings)
notes.content:
This update has a few enhancements:
- Performance enhancements.
- Fix for the Crash during the 2nd night.
- Button mapping enhancements.
- Aiming Angle enhancements.
- Game adjusted to one pistol instead of dual.
- Fix for not being able to pick pistol or ammo when dropping on the ground.

*Graphic setting changed, Please reset your graphic settings from the option menu then save, otherwise you might have fps drop due to Screen percentage value change.

notes.title: Update 0.9.9
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

Final update released with adding quick controller mapping which will be shown for the first time you play the game. please give your feedback and report bugs in the discussion section http://steamcommunity.com/app/642170/discussions 

The game is in final stage now and it will be released with the current build but that doesn't mean no change or update going to be added to the game, maybe more content will be added later which i hope with your support. the current stage is final and hopfully you can play the game without any issue .
 


Thanks

notes.title: Leaderboard and achievements is in final stage now
notes.content:
HI all

Now you can compete with your friends and the global player, we added steam global and friends Leaderboard, 

- Leaderboard added
- Minor fix for ammo box collision .
-Achievements  fixed .
-All the nights tested and works without any bugs so we are happy to announce the game is not in final stage and no bug expected .

Thanks

notes.title: Update 0.9.7.1 Released
notes.content:
*Controller rumble added on fire.
*Fixed Oculus Touch angle.
*Add offset for achievement position.
*Now you can put the mag in upward position and push the gun down to reload it .


Please report the bugs in discussions section , http://steamcommunity.com/app/642170/discussions/

Thanks for people who participated on fixing and testing these bugs .
